sources.title: L'evento alluvionale del 2-3 ottobre 2020 in Piemonte

curation_note.it: I valori idrometrici sono riferiti alla stazione di Borgosesia, circa 14,1 km a monte, e descrivono la severità della piena nel bacino. Non sono misure alla sezione del ponte né dimostrano da soli la causa del collasso.
curation_note.en: Hydrometric values refer to the Borgosesia station, approximately 14.1 km upstream, and describe flood severity in the basin. They are not bridge-section measurements and do not by themselves prove collapse causation.

provenance.method: Manual extraction from the official event report and station registry

caveats: The reported level and discharge thresholds refer to the upstream Borgosesia station, not the collapsed bridge section.
Values preceded by greater-than signs are thresholds reported by ARPA Piemonte, not exact peak measurements.
No bridge-section stage, discharge or hydrograph is assigned.
The report describes riverbed erosion and pier failure, but the hydrometric values alone do not prove collapse causation.
The event recurrence characterization in the report is not a collapse probability.
